data.desc: Liquidia Corporation is a biopharmaceutical company driven by science and compassion to revolutionize care for patients with challenging respiratory and vascular diseases. The company's current focus spans the development and commercialization of products in pulmonary hypertension and other applications of its proprietary PRINT Technology. PRINT enabled the creation of YUTREPIA (treprostinil) inhalation powder, approved for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), and in development for Raynaud's phenomenon secondary to systemic sclerosis (SSc-RP). The company is also developing L606, an investigational extended-release formulation of treprostinil administered twice daily via a next-generation nebulizer to treat PAH and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD).
